title: test(auth): the 401 re-check cases wait for the provider to listen before reporting a 401
body:
Fixes #32713 Clause-②: no Metadata-protocol: none ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么:只改一个测试文件 `ui/packages/auth/src/__tests__/AuthProvider.test.tsx`。「API 返回 401 后重新核对会话」那组用例,现在先等 `AuthProvider` 真正开始监听 401,再发出 401。 - 为什么改:原测试只等页面显示出用户名就发 401。React 可能晚一个任务才跑挂监听的那个 effect。401 落在这段空隙里就没人收,会话不会被重新核对,用例空等 10 秒后变红。实测 350 次里红 2 次,两次都是零监听。 - 风险与回滚:产品代码零改动,只动测试,不发布任何包。回滚 = revert 这一个 commit。 - 先看:`AuthProvider.test.tsx` 中 `providerListening` 与 `sessionReads()` 两处,以及 `signedIn()` 里新增的 `await providerListening`。 - 两分钟验证:`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/auth/src/__tests__/AuthProvider.test.tsx`,预期 20/20 通过。 - 需要你做的:无,席位落地。 ## What changes `signedIn()` used to return as soon as the DOM showed the signed-in user. The provider subscribes to the 401 reports (`sessionEndEvents`) in a passive effect of that same commit. React can run that effect in a later task than the DOM write, and a `waitFor` resolved by the DOM mutation can return in between. A 401 reported in that gap reaches no listener. Nothing re-checks, and "the server answers no session" waits out its whole `CHAIN_MS` budget. That is the 10018 ms red in run 43204347096. - `signedIn()` now also awaits `providerListening`. That promise is resolved by a `vi.spyOn(sessionEndEvents, 'subscribe')` wrapper the moment the provider subscribes, so the step resolves on the subscription itself, not a poll. `createAuthenticatedFetch.test.tsx` already uses `sessionEndEvents` directly as a test seam. - The "re-check read reached the server" waits now count `/get-session` reads only (`sessionReads()`). The same client sends `organization/list` once a session is held, and that request could land after the baseline count was taken. That is how the failing run passed its first wait with no re-check ever sent. - "The server says the session is live" now awaits the re-check's own `getSession()` answer (`recheckAnswered()`, which reads a spy on the real client's `getSession`) before it asserts that nothing changed. The provider awaited that same promise first, so its continuation has run. Before, the case asserted while the read was still in flight. No fixed settle is added: the two `setTimeout(r, 20)` settles left in the file are the ones `main` already had (the transport-error and no-session cases). - No budget changed (`CHAIN_MS` stays `10_000`). No `testTimeout`, skip, retry or quarantine. Every assertion is kept. The two re-check-count assertions are narrowed from "any request" to "a `get-session` read", which is strictly stronger. "No session held" is untouched and still counts every request. Landing spot: the expected file. The `[AuthProvider] Failed to load organizations: TypeError: client.listOrganizations is not a function` noise is not the cause. It comes from this file's own `createMockClient` cases in other describes (measured: those lines appear on a green run of this file alone). The 401 describe uses a real `createAuthClient`, whose `listOrganizations` exists and answers. No sibling double or product code was changed. ## Tests
Mechanism measurement (diagnostic loop, not committed) A temporary file looped the failing case N times per copy. It spied on `sessionEndEvents.subscribe`/`emit` to record the live listener count when identity appeared and when the 401 was reported, plus the auth URLs the client sent. Seven copies ran in parallel with `--maxWorkers=3` (the 4-vCPU runner's default), alongside the whole `ui/packages/auth` suite and two CPU-burning node processes, on a shared container. - `base` mode (main's timing: wait for "Alice", then report the 401): **2 of 350 iterations never cleared identity**. Both had `liveAtEmit=0`, and in both the client had sent only `/get-session` when "Alice" appeared (no `/organization/list` yet, so the passive effects had not run). Every iteration that cleared had `liveAtEmit=1`. - `fix` mode (same, plus wait for the subscription): **0 of 350** not cleared, 350 of 350 with `liveAtEmit=1`. In 4 of them the gap was open when "Alice" appeared (`liveAtAlice=0`), and the wait closed it. These are the cases the change carries.
File repetition (50 copies, under load) `rep.sh fix 50` wrote 50 copies of the committed file next to it and ran them in one `vitest run --maxWorkers=3 packages/auth/src/__tests__/`, with the whole sibling auth suite and two CPU burners as load. - Fix (`161a6a619`): copies 50/50 green, target case 50/50. - Base (`f1bb362c8`), same harness: also 50/50. The race is too rare to catch at file granularity (the diagnostic loop above measures about 1 in 175), so the loop pair is the before/after evidence, not this one.
Package checks (head 18225d05d, after merging main; final head 3c3fc6364 below) - `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/auth/` (from `ui/`): Test Files 45 passed (45), Tests 459 passed (459), lock VERDICT command-exit 0. - `pnpm run type-check` in `ui/packages/auth` (both `tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0. `--listFiles` (at 161a6a619) shows the test program compiles `AuthProvider.test.tsx`. - `npx eslint src/__tests__/AuthProvider.test.tsx` (at 161a6a619, same file bytes as head): exit 0.
Final head 3c3fc6364 (commit replacing the 20 ms settle with recheckAnswered()) - `AuthProvider.test.tsx`: 20 of 20 passed. `pnpm run type-check` in `ui/packages/auth` exit 0, and eslint on the file exit 0. - 24 of the 25 unlocked check scripts exit 0. Two items are NOT MEASURED because the shared verify lock was held for more than 46 minutes by another run and timed out three times (exit 99): `check:type-check-debt` (exit 3, its closure build) and `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`. The 50-copy repetition and the full auth suite were not re-run at this head either; their last readings are at `161a6a619` and `18225d05d` above. CI's check-runs at this head carry them: Test UI, Type Check · debt ledger and the rest are green.
## Acceptance notes - Observation, not filed (no repro at a public door): the provider's 401 listener is attached in a passive effect, so a 401 answered between the commit that sets identity and that effect's run is ignored, the same as one answered while no session is held. Requests the newly mounted children send cannot answer inside that window: their effects run in the same synchronous flush, and their responses arrive in a later task. Only a request already in flight before the session was set could. A request like that was sent with the pre-session credentials anyway, and the next API call re-reports. The test now waits for the precondition the case depends on rather than asserting through that window. ## Verification
Derived gates, head 18225d05d: 26 of 26 exit 0 `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 26 commands for the one changed path. Each ran at `18225d05d` with its exit code captured before any pipe, and all 26 exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: "26 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 26 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 26 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)". check-closing-keyword-parity (+ --self-test), check-comment-mask-corpus, check-sdui-manifest (+ --self-test), `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (Test Files 171 passed, 2 skipped; Tests 5062 passed, 2 skipped), check:duration-unit-keys, check:cross-package-test-inputs, check:dispatcher-error-vocabulary, check:driver-memory-census, check:engine-double-contract, check:gitlink-declared, check:nul-bytes, check:published-files, check:query-options-erasure, check:refd-timer-probe, check:registry-log-declared, check:rest-log-spy-declared, check:skill-identifier-liveness, check:test-source-alias, check:tier-file-adoption, check:type-check-coverage, check:type-check-debt, check:undeclared-dep-imports, check:watch-hint-literal, check:where-matcher. The Test UI shards, Lint UI and Type Check UI belong to CI, read from this PR's check-runs.
Changeset: none. Only a test file changes, and nothing any package ships moves (`ui/packages/auth` publishes `dist`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `LICENSE`), so this PR carries the `skip-changeset` label. --- _Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code/session_012MmDsRT6hvZsQH9dTzn4CA)_
